# Anti Vanish

**Category:** Misc  
**Aliases:** Anti Vanish, AntiVanish

## What it does

Detects when staff members go into vanish

Description basis: [publisher description](https://impactclient.net/features). The module's behavior on a stock Minecraft 26.3 server has not been verified unless separately documented in [research](../../RESEARCH.md).

## Client variants

### [Impact — Anti Vanish](https://impactclient.net/features)

Detects when staff members go into vanish

Basis: [publisher description](https://impactclient.net/features).

### [Future — AntiVanish](https://www.futureclient.net/#features)

Attempts to detect online server vanished users or restore invisible players from exploits.

Basis: [publisher description](https://www.futureclient.net/#features).
